name: Pizarro and the fall of the Inca
summary: With 168 men, Pizarro lands in an Inca empire torn by civil war and smallpox. At Cajamarca he seizes the emperor Atahualpa, takes a room full of gold as ransom, executes him anyway and marches on to Cuzco. The news, and the gold, reach Seville in 1534.

stops.note: Three ships and about 180 men sail south.
The Inca town they saw in 1528 is in ruins from the civil war.
The first Spanish town in Peru.
Atahualpa is ambushed and seized in the square; thousands of his attendants are killed.
Hernando Pizarro loots the great oracle shrine.
Atahualpa, his ransom paid, is garrotted.
Along the Inca royal road, the Qhapaq Ñan.
The Inca capital is entered and stripped of its gold.
